verses.pali: Saṁyutta Nikāya 22.26
verses.english: Linked Discourses 22.26

verses.pali: 3. Bhāravagga
verses.english: 3. The Burden

verses.pali: Assādasutta
verses.english: Gratification

verses.pali: Sāvatthinidānaṁ.
verses.english: At Sāvatthī.

verses.pali: “Pubbeva me, bhikkhave, sambodhā anabhisambuddhassa bodhisattasseva sato etadahosi:
verses.english: “Mendicants, before my awakening—when I was still unawakened but intent on awakening—I thought:

verses.pali: ‘ko nu kho rūpassa assādo, ko ādīnavo, kiṁ nissaraṇaṁ?
verses.english: ‘What’s the gratification, the drawback, and the escape when it comes to form …

verses.pali: Ko vedanāya assādo, ko ādīnavo, kiṁ nissaraṇaṁ?
verses.english: feeling …

verses.pali: Ko saññāya assādo, ko ādīnavo, kiṁ nissaraṇaṁ?
verses.english: perception …

verses.pali: Ko saṅkhārānaṁ assādo, ko ādīnavo, kiṁ nissaraṇaṁ?
verses.english: choices …

verses.pali: Ko viññāṇassa assādo, ko ādīnavo, kiṁ nissaraṇan’ti?
verses.english: and consciousness?’

verses.pali: Tassa mayhaṁ, bhikkhave, etadahosi:
verses.english: Then it occurred to me:

verses.pali: ‘yaṁ kho rūpaṁ paṭicca uppajjati sukhaṁ somanassaṁ, ayaṁ rūpassa assādo.
verses.english: ‘The pleasure and happiness that arise from form: this is its gratification.

verses.pali: Yaṁ rūpaṁ aniccaṁ dukkhaṁ vipariṇāmadhammaṁ, ayaṁ rūpassa ādīnavo.
verses.english: That form is impermanent, suffering, and perishable: this is its drawback.

verses.pali: Yo rūpasmiṁ chandarāgavinayo chandarāgappahānaṁ, idaṁ rūpassa nissaraṇaṁ.
verses.english: Removing and giving up desire and greed for form: this is its escape.

verses.pali: Yaṁ vedanaṁ paṭicca uppajjati sukhaṁ somanassaṁ, ayaṁ vedanāya assādo.
verses.english: The pleasure and happiness that arise from feeling …

verses.pali: Yaṁ vedanā aniccā dukkhā vipariṇāmadhammā, ayaṁ vedanāya ādīnavo.
Yo vedanāya chandarāgavinayo chandarāgappahānaṁ, idaṁ vedanāya nissaraṇaṁ.
Yaṁ saññaṁ paṭicca uppajjati …pe…
verses.english: perception …

verses.pali: yaṁ saṅkhāre paṭicca uppajjati sukhaṁ somanassaṁ, ayaṁ saṅkhārānaṁ assādo.
verses.english: choices …

verses.pali: Yaṁ saṅkhārā aniccā dukkhā vipariṇāmadhammā, ayaṁ saṅkhārānaṁ ādīnavo.
Yo saṅkhāresu chandarāgavinayo chandarāgappahānaṁ, idaṁ saṅkhārānaṁ nissaraṇaṁ.
Yaṁ viññāṇaṁ paṭicca uppajjati sukhaṁ somanassaṁ, ayaṁ viññāṇassa assādo.
verses.english: consciousness: this is its gratification.

verses.pali: Yaṁ viññāṇaṁ aniccaṁ dukkhaṁ vipariṇāmadhammaṁ, ayaṁ viññāṇassa ādīnavo.
verses.english: That consciousness is impermanent, suffering, and perishable: this is its drawback.

verses.pali: Yo viññāṇasmiṁ chandarāgavinayo chandarāgappahānaṁ, idaṁ viññāṇassa nissaraṇaṁ’.
verses.english: Removing and giving up desire and greed for consciousness: this is its escape.’

verses.pali: Yāvakīvañcāhaṁ, bhikkhave, imesaṁ pañcannaṁ upādānakkhandhānaṁ evaṁ assādañca assādato ādīnavañca ādīnavato nissaraṇañca nissaraṇato yathābhūtaṁ nābbhaññāsiṁ, neva tāvāhaṁ, bhikkhave, ‘sadevake loke samārake sabrahmake sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya anuttaraṁ sammāsambodhiṁ abhisambuddho’ti paccaññāsiṁ.
verses.english: As long as I didn’t truly understand these five grasping aggregates’ gratification, drawback, and escape in this way for what they are, I didn’t announce my supreme perfect awakening in this world with its gods, Māras, and Divinities, this population with its ascetics and brahmins, its gods and humans.

verses.pali: Yato ca khvāhaṁ, bhikkhave, imesaṁ pañcannaṁ upādānakkhandhānaṁ evaṁ assādañca assādato ādīnavañca ādīnavato nissaraṇañca nissaraṇato yathābhūtaṁ abbhaññāsiṁ;
verses.english: But when I did truly understand these five grasping aggregates’ gratification, drawback, and escape in this way for what they are, I announced my supreme perfect awakening in this world with its gods, Māras, and Divinities, this population with its ascetics and brahmins, its gods and humans.

verses.pali: athāhaṁ, bhikkhave, sadevake loke samārake sabrahmake sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya anuttaraṁ sammāsambodhiṁ abhisambuddhoti paccaññāsiṁ.
Ñāṇañca pana me dassanaṁ udapādi:
verses.english: Knowledge and vision arose in me:

verses.pali: ‘akuppā me vimutti; ayamantimā jāti; natthi dāni punabbhavo’”ti.
verses.english: ‘My freedom is unshakable; this is my last rebirth; now there’ll be no more future lives.’”

verses.pali: Pañcamaṁ.
